cityQuote: Salzburg is no place for my talent.
cityQuoteAttribution: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, in a letter to his father, 1778
heroTitle: Salzburg hero — Jiuguang Wang (CC BY-SA 3.0, Wikimedia Commons)
wordsPreamble:
- Almost everyone in Salzburg who works with visitors speaks English. A greeting in German is still the polite way to begin.
- Austrian German differs from Germany’s in greetings and food words. “Grüß Gott” and “Servus” are what you’ll hear.
- The local dialect is Bavarian, close to that of Munich, two hours away.
- Shops close early on Saturday and most stay closed on Sunday.
